title: sonchus tenerrimus subvar. dianae
intro: Sonchus tenerrimus subvar. dianae, commonly known as the tender sow thistle, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The plant has therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its therapeutic potential and to fully understand its effects on human health.
